records.claim: A 2000 NACE Rev.2 history exists, but the 2021 LEU-to-KAU unit change has not been shown to be fully backcast for B-D SCA.
records.evidence_summary: National metadata describes a 2000 revised series and comparability over time, yet explicitly notes that insignificant breaks may appear in some aggregates after the 2021 unit change. A 2021-base recalculation is not evidence of KAU backcasting.
records.remaining_uncertainty: No official B-D SCA bridge or explicit all-history KAU recalculation located.

records.claim: Current CANE Rev.2 B-D and SCA methods are documented, but no exact pre-2015 comparable start is certified.
records.evidence_summary: The national metadata says no major change in the last 15 years and describes current direct TRAMO-SEATS adjustment with annual model re-identification. The annex provides no historical start or pre-2015 bridge.
records.remaining_uncertainty: The 2000-01 API observation is not an official declaration of 2000-01 definition compatibility.

records.claim: Current IESS-derivation monthly history begins at the documented 2004-01 break.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat says une_rt_m past data were overwritten with break-corrected values and lists Austria's IESS-derived portion from 2004-01; the API marks that boundary b. Current series uses monthly LFS and SA.
records.remaining_uncertainty: The boundary month retains its break flag; no real-time-vintage claim.

records.claim: Current IESS-derivation monthly history begins at the documented 2009-01 break; the 2005-03 d flag is earlier.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat lists Germany's IESS-derived portion from 2009-01 and states current monthly history is overwritten; the methods portfolio identifies monthly LFS and TREND as the labelled online SA series.
records.remaining_uncertainty: TREND-versus-SA terminology remains a presentation limitation, not evidence for a pre-2009 clearance.

records.claim: IESS-derived history begins at 2009-01, but 2011-09 d remains unexplained.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat's 2009 IESS boundary and quarterly-LFS-benchmarked monthly method are documented; no official explanation was found that reconciles the later definition-difference flag.
records.remaining_uncertainty: 2011-09 definition-difference flag; registered counts are auxiliary, not the outcome.

records.claim: Current IESS-derivation monthly history begins at the documented 2009-01 break.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat lists Slovenia's IESS-derived portion from 2009-01, overwrites historical une_rt_m, and documents a quarterly-LFS benchmark with registered-count auxiliary information.
records.remaining_uncertainty: The boundary month remains flagged; the registered-unemployment rate is not substituted.

records.claim: The IESS portion begins in 2009, but state-space monthly estimates from 2023 revised only 2011-2022.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat names the 2009 IESS boundary and a 2023 state-space method with 2011-2022 revisions, but does not explicitly establish that 2009-2010 is comparable with the revised post-2011 construction.
records.remaining_uncertainty: Method relationship between 2009-2010 and 2011+; a revision floor is not automatically a comparable start.

records.claim: IESS-derived history begins at 2009-01, but 2009-12 d remains unexplained.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat documents 2009 as the IESS boundary and quarterly-LFS-benchmarked monthly estimates; no official explanation was found for the later definition-difference flag.
records.remaining_uncertainty: 2009-12 definition-difference flag; registered counts are auxiliary, not the outcome.

records.claim: Eurostat's IESS correction note lists 2009-01, but the stored API series has no 2009 b flag.
records.evidence_summary: The general correction note names Romania in the 2009 group; the specific downloaded SA/TOTAL monthly API series has only a 2003-12 d flag and no corresponding 2009 b flag.
break_periods: 2009-01 documented IESS boundary, API flag absent
records.remaining_uncertainty: Reconcile document and exact-series flag history before declaring a date.

records.claim: Official harmonised secondary-market Maastricht series is comparable from first observed month.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat defines national monthly MCBY as near-ten-year secondary-market government yields, says data compare over time, and lists no Austrian exception; routine representative-bond replacement preserves the registered concept.
records.remaining_uncertainty: Individual bond identifiers are not required to remain constant.

records.claim: Official harmonised secondary-market Maastricht series is comparable from first observed month.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat's harmonised MCBY definition and over-time comparability statement list no German concept exception; national central-bank data flow through ECB to Eurostat.
records.remaining_uncertainty: Individual bond identifiers are not required to remain constant.

records.claim: Secondary-market Maastricht concept begins after the documented primary-market period.
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat explicitly identifies Slovenian primary-market yields through 2003-10 and says MCBY data compare over time under the harmonised secondary-market definition thereafter.
records.remaining_uncertainty: 2025 observations carry e estimated-value flags; concept clearance does not erase quality flags.
